text: oh hm. i see it saying how many cells im painting but i do not see the paint at all
resolution: Paint registered cells (count rose) but no paint showed on the model. Traced the full paint pipeline and found every stage correct — paintRef dab accumulation, paintRuns run-merging, the atlas paint-run boxes drawn on top at the right scale (paintGrid==texels), the StaticSurface re-capture (driven by subtree_last_mutated_frame when the run boxes change on each paintBakeTick), and the mesh material '#ffffff'+textureKey sampling. The ONLY gate that hides paint is texView: paint renders solely through the atlas via textureKey, so with the textured view off the model shows flat solid colors and the strokes are invisible — the exact symptom. Paint mode and texView were decoupled (the status bar literally hints 'solid (toggle on!)'), so the view could sit off while painting. Fix couples them: the paint-mode auto-ensure effect now forces texView on (builds the texture if missing, which already turned it on, else explicitly setTexView(true)), and starting a stroke turns the view back on if it was toggled to solid — so the act of painting always reveals what you paint. TSX-only, hot-reloads, no rebuild. If paint STILL doesn't appear after this, the next suspect is the StaticSurface not re-capturing on paintBakeTick, but that path read as correct.
